entries.title: III John 1:1
segments: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in the truth.

entries.title: III John 1:2
segments: Beloved, in regard to all things I pray [that] you prosper and be in health, even as your soul prospers.

entries.title: III John 1:3
segments: For I rejoiced greatly when [the] brothers came and testified of the truth that is in you, even as you walk in the truth.

entries.title: III John 1:4
segments: I have no greater joy than these things, to hear that my children walk in the truth.

entries.title: III John 1:5
segments: Beloved, you do faithfully whatever you work for the brothers and for strangers,

entries.title: III John 1:6
segments: who in love bore witness of you before [the] church, whom you will do well to send forward worthily of God;

entries.title: III John 1:7
segments: because they went forth for His name's sake, taking nothing from the nations.

entries.title: III John 1:8
segments: Therefore we ought to entertain such, so that we might be co-workers in the truth.

entries.title: III John 1:9
segments: I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to have the preeminence among them, did not receive us.

entries.title: III John 1:10
segments: Therefore if I come, I will remember his deeds which he does, ranting against us with evil words. And not content [with] these, neither does he himself receive the brothers. And he forbids those who would, and casts [them] out of the church.

entries.title: III John 1:11
segments: Beloved, do not imitate the bad, but the good. He who does good is from God, but he who does evil has not seen God.

entries.title: III John 1:12
segments: Demetrius has good report by all, and by the truth itself. And we also bear witness, and you know that our witness is true.

entries.title: III John 1:13
segments: I had many things to write, but I will not write to you with pen and ink,

entries.title: III John 1:14
segments: but I trust I shall shortly see you, and we shall speak face to face. Peace [be] to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
